item.title: Courthouse Dogs – Canine Comfort Dogs Fill A Special Niche In The Judicial System
item.description: Going to court is something most people dread–for very good reasons. Regardless of which side of the matter a person is on, the experience is drenched in fear, stress, and confusion. But sometimes it’s unavoidable, and that’s why we have dogs.
